what-it-is.statement: Private Access analyzes user logs and suggests AI-powered recommendations for application segments. They are application segments pulled according to the filters set in the AI-Powered Recommendations Settings, and can be merged with existing defined application segments, added as newly defined application segments, or ignored.

quotes: Private Access (ZPA) analyzes user logs and suggests AI-powered recommendations for application segments.
AI-powered recommendations are application segments that have been pulled based on the filters you have configured in the AI-Powered Recommendations Settings.
These AI-powered recommendations for application segments can be merged with existing defined application segments, added as newly defined application segments, or ignored if they do not apply.

prerequisites-and-activation.statement: The page lists a minimum of 100 discovered applications and at least 20 enrolled users as prerequisites. The feature is activated with Activate Recommendations on the AI-Powered Recommendations page, which is populated with data only for users who activated it; if the page is not displayed, the page says to contact Zscaler Support.

quotes: Have a minimum of 100 discovered applications.
Have at least 20 enrolled users.
To activate this feature, click Activate Recommendations on the AI-Powered Recommendations page.

The AI-Powered Recommendations page is only populated with data for users who have activated it. If you want to enable this feature and the AI-Powered Recommendations page is not displayed, contact Zscaler Support.

generation.statement: The Next Availability date and the ability to generate AI-powered recommendations are determined by the subscription. Clicking Generate Recommendations overwrites any manually created recommendations.

quotes: The Next Availability date and the ability to generate AI-powered recommendations are determined by your subscription.
Clicking Generate Recommendations will overwrite any manually created recommendations.

segmentation-add-on.statement: An organization with the Segmentation add-on license can request to raise the total number of recommendations from 100 to 500.

quotes: If your organization has the Segmentation add-on license, you can request to update the total number of recommendations from 100 to 500.

merge-subscription.statement: The ability to merge an AI-powered recommendation with an existing defined application segment depends on your subscription.

quotes: The ability to merge an AI-powered recommendation with an existing defined application segment depends on your subscription.

attack-surface-reduction.statement: Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) is the percentage reduction in the attack surface, that is the percentage difference between potential users and recommended users.

quotes: Attack Surface Reduction: The percentage reduction in the attack surface (i.e., percentage difference between potential users and recommended users).

asr-operators.statement: In the Accept Recommendation window, the ASR field includes the operators Equals, Greater Than and Less Than, and the list is sorted in ascending order by ASR by default.

quotes: Click Accept to open the Accept Recommendation window.
The ASR includes the following operators: Equals (=), Greater Than (>), and Less Than (<).
By default, the list is sorted in ascending order by ASR.

asr-prepopulated.statement: In the Add AI-Powered Recommendation window, the prepopulated Attack Surface Reduction entry says that all recommendations that provide greater than a 75% reduction are presented.

quotes: The Add AI-Powered Recommendation window appears.
Review the following prepopulated information for the selected AI-powered recommendation:

Attack Surface Reduction: The percentage reduction in the attack surface (i.e., percentage difference between potential users and recommended users). All recommendations that provide greater than a 75% reduction are presented.

asr-categories.statement: When exploring recommendations by category, the page offers, under Attack Surface Reduction, the ranges >75%-100% and 0%-75% to view the available recommendations in the table.

quotes: View and explore available recommendations by category depending on your subscription.
Under Attack Surface Reduction, select >75%–100% or 0%–75% to view the available recommendations in the table based on the selected percentage range.

users-need-scim.statement: If SCIM Sync or SCIM Attributes for Policy is not enabled, the user recommendations appear as N/A.

quotes: If SCIM Sync or SCIM Attributes for Policy is not enabled, the user recommendations appear as N/A.

grouping-reasons.statement: A recommended application segment can be grouped by five categories of grouping reason: IP Similarity, User Access Similarity, Domain Name Similarity, Co-occurring Applications Similarity, and Ports and Protocols Similarity. The merge option combines application segments that have the same grouping reasons.

quotes: Grouping Reasons: The 5 categories that a recommended application segment can be grouped by (IP Similarity, User Access Similarity, Domain Name Similarity, Co-occurring Applications Similarity, and Ports and Protocols Similarity).
This option allows you to combine application segments that have the same grouping reasons.

multimatch-on-wildcard.statement: Before recommendations are added to application segments, Multimatch must be enabled on the wildcard application segment; otherwise an error message asks for Multimatch to be enabled on the selected wildcard application segment.

quotes: Before adding recommendations to application segments, ensure that Multimatch is enabled on the wildcard application segment. Failing to do so will trigger an error message prompting you to enable Multimatch on the selected wildcard application segment.

extranet-and-server-groups.statement: AI-powered recommendations do not support Extranet, and the step that adds a recommendation populates recommended server groups by default.

quotes: AI-powered recommendations do not support Extranet.
Recommended server groups are populated in this step by default.

ignore-and-diagnostics.statement: Ignoring a recommendation requires a reason in the Send Feedback window, and the ignored recommendation no longer appears in the table; ignored ones are listed under the Ignored Recommendations filter. The Diagnostics page shows up to 200 applications per recommended application segment and does not show additional ones. The availability of both the ignore functionality and the Diagnostics page depends on your subscription.

quotes: If you click Ignore, you must select a reason in the Send Feedback window.
The ignored recommended application segment will no longer appear in the table.
To view the list of ignored AI-powered recommended application segments, select the Ignored Recommendations filter.
The Diagnostics page shows up to 200 applications per recommended application segment. Any additional applications are not shown.
The availability of both the ignore functionality and the Diagnostics page for the recommended application segment depends on your subscription.

settings.statement: The AI-Powered Recommendations Settings exclude wildcards or subnets and selected defined application segments from recommendations, and choose whether recommended users are based on SCIM Group, SCIM Attribute or SAML Attribute. SCIM Sync must be enabled to display the SCIM criteria.

quotes: Wildcards/Subnets: Enter wildcards or subnets that you want to exclude from recommendations.
Defined Application Segments: Select a defined application segment that you want to exclude from the drop-down menu.
SCIM Group: Recommended users are based on the SCIM groups associated with the user.
SCIM Attribute: Recommended users are displayed based on the selected SCIM attribute.
SAML Attribute: Recommended users are are displayed based on the selected SAML attribute (e.g., Department).
You must enable SCIM Sync to display SCIM criteria (i.e., SCIM Attribute or SCIM Group).

subscription-tiers.title: Which subscriptions allow generating and merging AI-powered recommendations
subscription-tiers.detail: The pages say the Next Availability date, the ability to generate recommendations and the ability to merge depend on the subscription, and that the Segmentation add-on license allows raising the total from 100 to 500. They do not name the subscriptions or tiers.

application-types.title: How Application Types are identified for recommendations
application-types.detail: The pages describe the grouping reasons but not how application types are identified or what the recommendation algorithm uses beyond user logs. The only API trace found is appRecommendationId, already covered in the application segment field subject.
